items.title: Persist an exact RED for TEST-transition fresh-PASS reuse
items.context: Convert the isolated reproduction into a production-path test using the real local CLI sequence. It must prove current code reaches commandExecutions=0 yet returns infra_failure solely because trusted lifecycle metadata is dirty; retain a negative control for pre-existing human/external dirt.

items.title: Make trusted lifecycle metadata and reused PASS persist atomically
items.context: Differentiate canonical metadata created by the immediately preceding authorized lifecycle flow from pre-existing or untrusted dirt, and include only admissible generated paths in the isolated CAS/closeout writer transaction. Never allow arbitrary dirty files or prose/event-type spoofing to become trusted.

items.title: Verify one-shot convergence and fail-closed security boundaries
items.context: The real TEST transition followed by mandatory validate must return PASS, disposition reused and commandExecutions=0 in one invocation with a clean tree. Human confirmation, forged event, malformed receipt, unrelated dirty source/config, concurrent HEAD change and writer failure must remain rejected or roll back safely.
